verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships an official, documented CLI (pipecat-ai[cli]). A hands-on runtime probe confirmed `pipecat --help` lists init, cloud, eval and context-hub. Several of these are AI-native: init writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and context-hub registers an MCP server and builds a local index for coding agents. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of the CLI in real-world use.
